nodes.label: File Associations (Open With)
nodes.rationale: role: Editor + rank: Alternate registers Forge as a handler for common code/text files so it appears in the OS Open With menu without seizing ownership from the user's default app; files arrive via the main-process open-file handler. A public.data/content/text catch-all broadens the match to any file.

nodes.label: extraResources ts-libs
nodes.rationale: electron-builder strips *.d.ts from node_modules when collecting deps, so typescript's lib.*.d.ts never make it into the asar — breaking every global type and IntelliSense (e.g. gql tagged templates fail TS2345). extraResources is copied verbatim, so ship the lib files there; project-service.ts resolves them from Contents/Resources/ts-libs at runtime.

nodes.label: asarUnpack native binaries
nodes.rationale: node-pty ships a native .node binary that cannot run from inside the asar; tsx/esbuild (the loader spawned for the TS/TSX step debugger) also can't be read inside app.asar, so they must live unpacked on disk (app.asar.unpacked).
